## 📊 Live Dashboard (Observable JS)

This chart is rendered **live in the browser** using Observable JS. No backend required!

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar
viewof callVolume = Inputs.range([0, 100], {label: "Simulated Call Volume", step: 1})
viewof region = Inputs.radio(["US-East", "EU-West", "Asia-Pacific"], {label: "Region", value: "US-East"})
```

```{ojs}
// Generate some mock data based on inputs
data = {
  const points = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
    points.push({
      hour: i,
      calls: Math.max(0, Math.floor(callVolume * (Math.sin((i - 14) / 4) + 1.5) + (Math.random() * 10 - 5)))
    });
  }
  return points;
}

// Render the chart
Plot.plot({
  title: `Projected Call Traffic (${region})`,
  subtitle: "24-hour forecast based on historical models",
  y: { grid: true, label: "Active Calls" },
  x: { label: "Hour of Day" },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(data, {x: "hour", y: "calls", fill: "steelblue", fillOpacity: 0.3}),
    Plot.lineY(data, {x: "hour", y: "calls", stroke: "steelblue", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## 🏗️ System Architecture

Using **tabsets**, we can organize complex information cleanly.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 🗺️ Flow Overview

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    User((👤 User)) -->|Dials| Asterisk[📞 Asterisk PBX]
    Asterisk -->|Stasis| App[⚡ Node.js App]
    
    subgraph Core Logic
        App -->|Create| Session[Call Session]
        Session -->|Stream Audio| Google[☁️ Google Speech API]
        Google -->|Transcript| Session
    end
    
    Session -->|Feedback| User
    
    click App "https://nodejs.org" "Node.js"
    click Google "https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text" "Google Cloud"
```

## ⏱️ Call Sequence

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Caller 📱
    participant A as Asterisk 📞
    participant S as Server 🖥️
    participant G as Google Speech ☁️

    C->>A: Dial Number
    A->>S: Stasis Start (ARI)
    S->>A: Answer Channel
    A-->>C: Connected
    
    par Audio Stream
        A->>S: RTP Stream
        S->>G: Audio Stream
    and Transcription
        G-->>S: Transcript (Interim)
        S-->>C: "I heard you say..."
    end
    
    C->>A: Hangup
    A->>S: Stasis End
```

## 📝 Description

The **VoiceFlow** system handles calls in real-time.
- **RTP Stream**: Audio is intercepted and sent to Google.
- **WebSocket**: Transcription updates are pushed to the frontend.
- **Latency**: Typically < 500ms for partial results.

:::

## 🧩 Component Breakdown

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}
### 📡 Server-Side
The `AriControllerServer` manages the connection to Asterisk.

- **Protocol**: WebSocket (ARI)
- **Role**: State Managment
- **Scale**: Horizontal
:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
<!-- Spacer -->
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
### ☁️ Cloud Services
Computation heavy tasks are offloaded.

- **Speech-to-Text**: Google Cloud
- **Storage**: S3 / Local
- **Logging**: Winston / CloudWatch
:::
